entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is VF-881-92B.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see an order for the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes. Is that correct?
That's the one. I need to send them back.
I can certainly look into that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They just don't work for me. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but these cycling shoes are giving me terrible blisters after every ride. I just want a refund.
I understand, getting blisters is definitely a reason to return them. Comfort is key. Let me just check the policy against your delivery date.
Just tell me yes or no. Can I return them?

Yes, you can. I see they were delivered 11 days ago, and our policy for standard items like shoes is 90 days for a full refund. You are well within that window. I've just initiated the return for you.

I just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Simply pack the shoes in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse scans it in, your refund will be processed.
Got the email. Fine. That's all I needed.
Perfect. Was there anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
